other_conditions: Applicant must be registered under the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and have an active membership
Eligibility begins three months after registration
Applicant must submit the application within two months from the date of delivery
Benefits are provided only for the birth of two children
Applicant must not have received the same benefits under any other central or state scheme
Applicant must not have applied to any other department for the same benefits
Applicant must have worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days during the preceding one year
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 is provided to eligible women construction workers during their maternity period.
documents_required: certified copy of the ANC card
certificate issued by the medical officer
